Hawaii Office of Elections, certified results of the 2026-08-08 Primary Election. Statewide Summary (elections.hawaii.gov/wp-content/results/2026 Primary/summary.txt) cross-checked candidate-for-candidate against the rendered Statewide Summary (same directory, histatewide.pdf) and consistent with the official STATEMENT OF VOTE (hi_sov.pdf, "PRIMARY ELECTION 2026 ... August 8, 2026"); all fetched 2026-09-11. Contest "CONLEY, Jordan S." (G), 402 votes. Green nominee: sole candidate in the Dist I Green primary. His 402 votes are the lowest nominated-partisan total, which is the bar the nonpartisan second prong is measured against.

Hawaii Office of Elections, certified results of the 2026-08-08 Primary Election. Statewide Summary (elections.hawaii.gov/wp-content/results/2026 Primary/summary.txt) cross-checked candidate-for-candidate against the rendered Statewide Summary (same directory, histatewide.pdf) and consistent with the official STATEMENT OF VOTE (hi_sov.pdf, "PRIMARY ELECTION 2026 ... August 8, 2026"); all fetched 2026-09-11. Contest "BERNING, Nathan M." (N), 977 votes. Nonpartisan, qualified under HRS 12-41(b) second prong: 977 >= 402, the lowest vote received by a nominated partisan (Conley, Green). Fails the 10% prong (977 of 129,024 = 0.76%), which is not required when the second prong is met.
